scope: Twelve added architecture/data/infrastructure notations; sixteen total including the generic semantic overview. Requested M9 notation increment only; other M9 work remains open.

realInference.limits: One final fresh case, not a statistical reliability comparison. CLI token usage includes provider overhead; no price or cheapest-model claim.

developmentFindings: Initial clarification was ignored on first analysis; now forwarded and tested.
A C4 proposal must retain its own identity beside the local structural overview.
View focus may contain supporting context; actual view nodes follow notation roles and need a core subject.
Explicit NOT NULL contradictions are now rejected using conservative deterministic SQL evidence; the real incorrect output is kept as a negative regression.
A typed step can infer missing links between existing objects from disclosed evidence in the same approved request; no additional automatic repair call.
Stable tool connection keys use resolved semantic identities; recorded output tests explicitly rebase keys for a different project namespace.
Publication now finishes the returned staged job, including the final diagram and all completion flags.
Changes inside a declaration could remove the class model from reconciliation context when its signature stayed equal. Body changes now include the model and an indexed/concept distinction.

limitations: Base editable notations, not complete UML/C4 conformance. No combined sequence fragments, parallel state regions or runtime discovery.
ERD multiplicities are textual; database views do not execute DDL or provision infrastructure.
SQL constraint facts cover complete unquoted CREATE TABLE statements without strings/comments; ambiguous or unsupported syntax is not certified.
Other notation types are exercised with authored fixtures and domain validators, not all by real inference.
Reconciliation regression provider is simulated; actual model inference in this increment was exercised for diagram generation.
